title: In 1995, this American doctor delivered a baby girl; 25 years later, he delivered her son
summary_full: In a heartwarming turn of events, Dr. Bryan Cox delivered Lauren Cortez in 1995 and later welcomed her son Logan James in 2020, both at the same Texas hospital. This special reunion was marked by Cox recreating a cherished photo from Lauren’s birth while singing 'Happy Birthday' to both occasions. Surprising family ties were also unveiled between Dr. Cox and Logan's family, making the moments even more memorable.
